findings.desc: AuthorityClientAuth.customerApiKey comment still says the customer API key is used only for mutating Authority requests, but this story now uses it for protected GET reads via listJobVerdicts/authenticated GET. Update the field comment so future maintainers do not infer that GET paths must stay keyless.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed the AuthorityClientAuth customerApiKey documentation so it states customer keys are used for mutating requests and protected reads; verified with npm --prefix packages/main run build and node packages/main/dist/tasks/authority-client-smoke.js.
